capabilities: Filter the File explorer by a chosen top-level folder
Hide files and folders whose names match a configurable pattern
Toggle the folder and name filters from command palette commands
Keep hidden items reachable through search, links, backlinks, and the quick switcher
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes manual installation steps and a security contact policy.
intentEvidence: Plugin for Obsidian to provide filtering on top-level folders in the File explorer.
problem: Obsidian's File explorer shows all folders at once, so users with many top-level folders lack a way to focus on one folder without maintaining separate notebooks.

relations.evidence: Use filtering alongside other File explorer plugins, including Drag and Drop Sort.
Switch context without maintaining multiple notebooks - like OneNote sections.

summary: File explorer filter that switches the explorer view to one top-level folder and hides files or folders matching a configurable name pattern.
